ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels appearing as localized clusters representing approximately 15% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across the main body of the lobes; high-intensity white circular clusters are concentrated on the distal tips and along the upper trailing edge margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (5-15 pixels) extending across the entire linear boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve leading to sharp, vertically-oriented distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular high-contrast white pixels (barnacle colonization) localized on the outer lateral margins of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical cleft or traumatic indentation is visible on the inner-third of the right lobe's trailing edge, separate from the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Several isolated, high-intensity white circular spots are scattered across the interior dark-pixel regions of both fluke lobes.
